items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Katherine' as part of a list of people from the Captain Dunham Show, but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not respond with any personal interaction or relationship details.

ctx.x: Yeah. And, they had a show coming up called 'Blue Holidays.' Miss Waters was the star and people like Jimmy and Katherine some people from the Captain Dunham Show ... and one of the girls in the show was, what was her name?
